subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir plans to sneak into the tower, then quickly climb up to the top floor, arm himself, and bring whatever weapons he can carry back to the prisoners.
source_quote: He plans to sneak into the tower, then quickly climb up to the top floor, arm himself, and bring whatever weapons he can carry back to the prisoners

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir believes the quote from Sage Vof Klownits applies to his plan, though he never read the opus.
source_quote: Like the great Sage Vof Klownits described in his opus, an opus that Zalthir never read, "No plan survives encounter with the enemy."

subject: Daz
fact: Daz shouts in Thorin’s brain, "Plan B."
source_quote: Daz shouts in Thorin’s brain, "Plan B."

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin shouts back, "What is Plan B?"
source_quote: Thorin shouts back, "What is Plan B?"

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir mumbles, "Get in here and help us?"
source_quote: Zalthir mumbles, "Get in here and help us?"

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin tries to overpower the elite warrior, whom Sarith identified as Imbros but fails.
source_quote: He tries to overpower the elite warrior, whom Sarith identified as Imbros but fails.

subject: Imbros
fact: Imbros is amused by the turn of events and is tempted to kill Thorin but chooses not.
source_quote: Imbros is, in turn, amused by the turn of events and is tempted to kill Thorin but chooses not.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir, who has spent several days in captivity, tried to go to for a classic opening move but forgot to position his hand, and instead of pushing Imbros, he caressed him.
source_quote: Zalthir, who has spent several days in captivity, tried to go to for a classic opening move but forgot to position his hand, and instead of pushing Imbros, he caressed him.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum decides that an armed cleric is better than a disarmed cleric and follows his fellow prisoners to the armory.
source_quote: Grygum decides that an armed cleric is better than a disarmed cleric and follows his fellow prisoners to the armory.

subject: Prince Derendil
fact: Prince Derendil declares, "I am already armed in this hideous form, and it would bring me great joy to kill this drow."
source_quote: Prince Derendil declares, "I am already armed in this hideous form, and it would bring me great joy to kill this drow."

subject: Daz
fact: Daz focuses his mind on Imbros and speaks the incantation of Mind Sliver, but the Drow is unaffected.
source_quote: Daz focuses his mind on Imbros and speaks the incantation of Mind Sliver, but the Drow is unaffected.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir tries to strike one of the two drow guards with his unarmed fists. His fists land ineffectively.
source_quote: Zalthir tries to strike one of the two drow guards with his unarmed fists. His fists land ineffectively.

subject: Sarith
fact: As the Sarith strikes his erstwhile comrade, he curses him in a unique way that makes the Drow curse each other.
source_quote: As the Sarith strikes his erstwhile comrade, he curses him in a unique way that makes the Drow curse each other.

subject: Jimjar
fact: Jimjar says, "You should have taken that bet," and forces everyone to listen to him.
source_quote: You should have taken that bet," everyone hears Jimjar say. The Deep Gnome has mastered Spool’s telepathy and forces everyone to listen to him.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum stands over the dwarf, and then, with a moment’s incantation and a gentle touch, bloodless flesh becomes rosy, gashes close, and broken bones knit instantly with a rush of magical healing.
source_quote: Grygum stands over the dwarf, and then, with a moment’s incantation and a gentle touch, bloodless flesh becomes rosy, gashes close, and broken bones knit instantly with a rush of magical healing.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz remembers how magic missiles work. It’s not one dart, but three darts.
source_quote: Daz has recovered from the disastrous opening gambit and remembers how magic missiles work. It’s not one dart, but three darts.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin slips out of range of the Drow, climbs upstairs, and puts on some armor.
source_quote: Thorin slips out of range of the Drow, climbs upstairs, and puts on some armor.

subject: Imbros
fact: Imbros realizes that if he doesn’t stop these slaves, Ilvara might decide his fate should be precisely like Sarith’s.
source_quote: Imbros now realizes he’s fighting for his life and realizes that if he doesn’t stop these slaves, Ilvara might decide his fate should be precisely like Sarith’s.

subject: Imbros
fact: Imbros remembers what happened to Drow who failed and decides to deal with the revolt on his own.
source_quote: He’s tempted to call for help and remembers what happened to Drow, who failed. "No, better to deal with this on my own."

subject: Sarith
fact: Sarith suddenly goes mad. He is about to start screaming at the top of his lungs.
source_quote: Sarith suddenly goes mad. He is about to start screaming at the top of his lungs.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum notices and reaches into Sarith’s mind to tell Sarith to focus on his spirituality and how much better things will be if he chooses to focus his rage on the divine rather than on the material.
source_quote: Grygum notices and reaches into Sarith’s mind to tell Sarith to focus on his spirituality and how much better things will be if he chooses to focus his rage on the divine rather than on the material.

subject: Sarith
fact: Sarith is confused and calmed.
source_quote: Sarith is confused and calmed.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum smiles. The lessons of his cult have served him well.
source_quote: Grygum smiles. The lessons of his cult have served him well.

subject: Sarith
fact: Sarith smiles, too, when his sword cuts Imbros down.
source_quote: And Sarith smiles, too, when his sword cuts Imbros down.

subject: Sarith's madness
fact: Sarith's madness is triggered by Prince Derendil's death, but the reason it affects him so deeply is not explained.
source_quote: Sarith suddenly goes mad. He is about to start screaming at the top of his lungs. For some reason, this death affected him deeply.

subject: Imbros's fate
fact: Imbros fears Ilvara might decide his fate should be precisely like Sarith’s, but Sarith’s own fate is not specified.
source_quote: Imbros now realizes he’s fighting for his life and realizes that if he doesn’t stop these slaves, Ilvara might decide his fate should be precisely like Sarith’s.
